title: event_store/store.zig:337 StoreError.InstanceNotFound on TC-DB-03-01 store.append
notes: Follow-up D2 from the WF03-gh377-20260804 rework-1 retry: after successful tenant provisioning (ISS-0114 fixed), TC-DB-03-01 store.append fails with StoreError.InstanceNotFound at store.zig:337. The event instance was just provisioned but the store cannot locate it for append.
root_cause: Likely a race between tenant schema visibility being committed and the event_store's lookup query. The previous C23502 cascade may have masked this; now that tenants provision correctly, the underlying assumption (schema visible to event_store.lookup) is violated.
candidate_resolution: Add explicit commit barrier between tenant schema creation and event_store.lookup in the test flow; or change event_store.lookup to qualify the tenant schema explicitly (schema_name.table_name) rather than relying on the current connection's search_path. Verify idempotency invariant holds.
acceptance_criteria: No regression in already-passing event_store tests
prevention: event_store.lookup must qualify its tenant schema explicitly; never rely on the connection's search_path at lookup time.
Test flows that combine tenant provisioning + event_store.append must explicitly observe the schema-creation commit before the first append.
